In the summer a Tom Collins, which is basically an alcoholic lemonade:

  • Juice from a whole lemon
  • Big spoonful of simple syrup (equal parts sugar and water brought to a boil then cooled)
  • 2 oz of gin
  • Shake well with ice
  • Strain into a tall glass with lots of ice
  • Top off with seltzer

It's fantastic on a hot day.
